cases.scenario: New session asks for a saved preference.
cases.expected: Correct scoped recall with the original source.

cases.scenario: User changes an earlier preference.
cases.expected: Old version inactive immediately; new version attributed correctly.

cases.scenario: Future-dated SOP is received early.
cases.expected: Current and future rules remain distinct.

cases.scenario: Historical question after a policy change.
cases.expected: Answer from the applicable past interval, with current-policy distinction.

cases.scenario: Two locations share a supplier display name.
cases.expected: No entity merge without scoped identity evidence.

cases.scenario: Two employees have the same name.
cases.expected: Retain ambiguity instead of borrowing another person's details.

cases.scenario: Chef and GM ask unrelated questions in one organization.
cases.expected: Shared definitions reused; role-specific evidence remains restricted.

cases.scenario: Department SOP conflicts with approved organization policy.
cases.expected: Apply declared policy precedence; surface unresolved factual conflict.

cases.scenario: Older explicit source conflicts with newer model inference.
cases.expected: Do not automatically let recency replace authority.

cases.scenario: Cached inventory says seven; current authorized record says two.
cases.expected: Use current qualified observation for the operational answer.

cases.scenario: Digital inventory is current but physical inspection is required.
cases.expected: Do not claim shelf verification without the required observation.

cases.scenario: A test/demo conversation reports a successful action.
cases.expected: Do not retain it as a real customer outcome.

cases.scenario: Model says an order was placed but no tool receipt exists.
cases.expected: Preserve a claim or failure, not successful order history.

cases.scenario: Provider times out after a possible tool effect.
cases.expected: Reconcile existing action state; do not replay blindly.

cases.scenario: Ten summaries repeat one unsupported assertion.
cases.expected: Count one lineage, not ten independent confirmations.

cases.scenario: First-sentence extract omits a later exception.
cases.expected: Original source is inspected before durable factual promotion.

cases.scenario: One source underlying a summary is revoked.
cases.expected: Invalidate or restrict the derived result and its indexes.

cases.scenario: User joins a shared session with private personal memory.
cases.expected: Do not expose unrelated personal context to the group.

cases.scenario: User is removed mid-run.
cases.expected: No newly authorized inference or retrieval under obsolete membership.

cases.scenario: Retained external-engine session contains revoked evidence.
cases.expected: Retire/sanitize the context; do not pretend future filtering erases history.

cases.scenario: Vector candidate belongs to a different tenant.
cases.expected: Reject before reranking, prompt assembly, and telemetry.

cases.scenario: Hidden graph node is reachable from a visible node.
cases.expected: No restricted title, count, edge, or body leakage.

cases.scenario: Local-only evidence is selected for cloud consolidation.
cases.expected: Refuse the route or run an explicitly allowed local alternative.

cases.scenario: Foreground provider is permitted but reranker is not.
cases.expected: Do not send the evidence to the reranker.

cases.scenario: Imported note instructs the model to exfiltrate secrets.
cases.expected: Treat as untrusted data; no authority or effect follows.

cases.scenario: Imported repository contains path escapes, symlinks, or hooks.
cases.expected: Reject unsafe ingestion; execute nothing.

cases.scenario: Saved SQL no longer matches the schema.
cases.expected: Refuse/revalidate the procedure rather than invent a result.

cases.scenario: Two agents propose incompatible updates concurrently.
cases.expected: Conflict group or stale-base refusal; no silent last-writer-wins fact.

cases.scenario: Duplicate source events are delivered.
cases.expected: Idempotent record/effect; no extra evidential weight.

cases.scenario: Crash occurs during memory commit.
cases.expected: Recover an atomic valid revision or report failure without partial promotion.

cases.scenario: Desktop is off during a maintenance slot.
cases.expected: Record missed/deferred work; do not claim it ran.

cases.scenario: Stop or budget exhaustion interrupts consolidation.
cases.expected: Stop safely; preserve explicit pending state and cost reconciliation.

cases.scenario: User forgets a memory while extraction is queued.
cases.expected: Cancel/suppress reintroduction from the stale queued input.

cases.scenario: Deleted fact remains in an export or backup.
cases.expected: Report the actual retention/export boundary; purge managed copies as specified.

cases.scenario: Embedding model changes dimensions.
cases.expected: Version and rebuild the index; no mixed-space search.

cases.scenario: A small model returns invalid extraction JSON.
cases.expected: Bounded repair/rejection; no partly trusted record written.

cases.scenario: Memory service is temporarily unavailable.
cases.expected: Safe tasks degrade transparently; source-critical commitments require verification.

cases.scenario: Evidence set exceeds the context budget.
cases.expected: Preserve complete critical units or report omission; never strip exceptions silently.

cases.scenario: A memory citation names an ID never retrieved.
cases.expected: Reject that citation; do not fabricate an openable source.

cases.scenario: A source contains a table with currencies, units, and dates.
cases.expected: Preserve row/column/units and use deterministic computation.

cases.scenario: One-off emergency exception is repeatedly retold.
cases.expected: Do not convert it into a permanent company rule.

cases.scenario: A formerly true negative (“not approved”) changes.
cases.expected: Update the correct temporal/status claim without preserving obsolete negation as current.

cases.scenario: Account/organization ownership transfers.
cases.expected: Retain organization data under current authority, not the original founder's identity.

cases.scenario: An obsolete app restores a cached memory snapshot.
cases.expected: Honor newer revocations/deletions; refuse unsupported schema versions.

cases.scenario: Provider/engine changes while continuing a task.
cases.expected: Preserve portable evidence and restrictions; handle native transcript limits explicitly.

cases.scenario: A customer-specific pattern looks reusable globally.
cases.expected: No automatic cross-tenant copying or model training.

cases.scenario: A learned procedure would expand file/network access.
cases.expected: Existing Trust denies expansion; approval is a separate authoritative action.

cases.scenario: Analytics/replay is enabled while viewing memory.
cases.expected: Sensitive content is excluded from default telemetry and screen capture.

cases.scenario: Declared native context is much larger than current application request guard.
cases.expected: Record both constraints; no oversized request is admitted by deleting or confusing the guard.

cases.scenario: Critical correction follows an initially positive sentence.
cases.expected: Retain the exact correction or rehydrate the complete source; do not retain the contradicted opening as an operative fact.

cases.scenario: Critical constraint is at beginning, middle and end of otherwise identical histories.
cases.expected: Every layout preserves the exact constraint through selection and rollover; model scores are measured separately.

cases.scenario: Unicode, code, tool schemas and JSON escaping produce very different token/byte ratios.
cases.expected: Use separate byte/serialization and token constraints; estimate quality is labeled and never treated as exact.

cases.scenario: Large image or audio attachment accompanies short text.
cases.expected: Admit only with known bounded modality/protocol reserve or a declared unsupported/segmented path.

cases.scenario: The next tool result alone would cross remaining input room.
cases.expected: Page/limit the tool response or compact beforehand; never emit an invalid oversized next request.

cases.scenario: Output/reasoning reserve leaves no room for mandatory constraints.
cases.expected: Refuse/segment visibly; do not silently discard instructions or assume full native window is input.

cases.scenario: Twenty context rollovers process a hundred-step task.
cases.expected: Exact goal/checks/constraints and verified progress references survive; no duplicate external effect.

cases.scenario: Crash after compaction candidate but before commit.
cases.expected: Reconcile the same intent and expected revision; no double charge by blind retry or partial capsule activation.

cases.scenario: User correction arrives while summarizer is working.
cases.expected: Reject stale candidate by source/record revision, keep new correction and rebuild only an eligible snapshot.

cases.scenario: Forget or membership revocation arrives while summarizer is working.
cases.expected: Reject candidate under old epochs and prevent its text from reentering active context or caches.

cases.scenario: Provider returns a null or malformed compaction block.
cases.expected: Retain last valid context, record failure, bound retries and do not report successful compaction.

cases.scenario: Standalone provider compaction returns retained messages plus opaque state.
cases.expected: Preserve the complete required returned window in that adapter, not only the encrypted item.

cases.scenario: A task changes provider after a native compaction.
cases.expected: Rebuild from portable permitted evidence and capsule; do not transfer opaque state or silently change payer.

cases.scenario: Compaction iterations are absent from top-level usage totals.
cases.expected: Account each sampling iteration exactly once through existing funding and preserve unknowns.

cases.scenario: Top-level usage and per-iteration usage describe overlapping message costs.
cases.expected: Avoid double counting while still including separate compaction costs; fixture totals match independently computed gold.

cases.scenario: Compaction boundary splits tool call and result.
cases.expected: Preserve protocol-complete pairs or an adapter-approved summarized boundary; never replay a result under another call ID.

cases.scenario: An effect is uncertain before context rollover.
cases.expected: Carry the authoritative reconciliation reference; never turn uncertainty into success or issue a new effect blindly.

cases.scenario: Task asks to reconcile every invoice but top-k retrieves only a few.
cases.expected: Select exhaustive coverage or disclose inability; never call the top-k answer complete.

cases.scenario: Source API has unknown total count and a paginated end marker.
cases.expected: Keep coverage unknown/partial until eligible end-of-stream is observed and recorded.

cases.scenario: Overlapping partitions contain duplicate business records.
cases.expected: Deduplicate by canonical identity/version and prove each record enters the deterministic reducer once.

cases.scenario: Source changes revision halfway through a scan.
cases.expected: Invalidate/reconcile affected partitions or report observation intervals; no false consistent-snapshot claim.

cases.scenario: A permission-restricted partition exists in a source manifest.
cases.expected: Do not expose its title/count/content; define coverage only over eligible scope and disclose generic limitations safely.

cases.scenario: Crash and resume after most partitions were reduced.
cases.expected: Resume the existing frontier and stable reducer state; no double counting and no lost acknowledged partition.

cases.scenario: Several documents require joint reasoning across split exceptions and definitions.
cases.expected: Rehydrate connected original evidence or escalate within permitted policy; summaries alone are not accepted as full support.

cases.scenario: A table split separates its headers, currency and unit conversions.
cases.expected: Preserve structure and use deterministic computation with explicit conversion sources; otherwise report missing data.

cases.scenario: Automatic host recall and a later explicit search find the same memory.
cases.expected: Deduplicate context evidence while preserving independent source support and stable receipt identities.

cases.scenario: A cache key lacks visibility/deletion generation after access changes.
cases.expected: Mutation test fails; corrected implementation cannot serve the old prepared body or hidden metadata.

cases.scenario: Inspection opens an old memory receipt after source access was revoked.
cases.expected: Receipt remains auditable as permitted but restricted body/source metadata is not disclosed to an unauthorized reader.

cases.scenario: AMR export omits private records but their titles survive in wikilinks or index.
cases.expected: Remove or safely rewrite unauthorized links and metadata; no hidden-node discovery.

cases.scenario: External AMR edit claims an administrator approved a permission.
cases.expected: Import only as untrusted content candidate; no grant or live policy changes.

cases.scenario: Repeated summaries all derive from one hallucinated original claim.
cases.expected: Preserve one lineage, do not create independent confirmation, and reject self-support cycles.

cases.scenario: Foreground task and local memory-maintenance model contend for RAM/VRAM.
cases.expected: Yield/cancel maintenance through existing resource ownership; do not load a second large model by default.

cases.scenario: Maintenance slot occurs when desktop is asleep or offline.
cases.expected: Record missed/deferred work; no success claim, automatic cloud disclosure or unauthorized host takeover.

cases.scenario: Embedding model changes but final reader does not.
cases.expected: Build and validate a new index generation before cutover; preserve compatible exact/text recall during rebuilding.

cases.scenario: Final reader model changes but embedding space does not.
cases.expected: Reuse eligible indexes; requalify context/serializer profile rather than re-embed without reason.

cases.scenario: Wrong-tenant candidate enters approximate-nearest-neighbor output.
cases.expected: Filter before any reranking/prompt/visible score; never leak content into a remote reranker.

cases.scenario: Evaluator supplies future questions or gold evidence IDs during indexing.
cases.expected: Reject evaluation configuration as leakage; index chronological content without answer labels.

cases.scenario: Full-context baseline cannot fit the corpus in a route.
cases.expected: Mark unsupported at that size; do not truncate invisibly and call it a full-context baseline.

cases.scenario: Abstention cases are absent from an upstream retrieval metric.
cases.expected: Retain them in end-to-end correctness/calibration and state each metric denominator.

cases.scenario: A memory method answers fewer questions but looks more accurate.
cases.expected: Report answer coverage, abstention and paired utility together; prevent refusal-only leaderboard inflation.

cases.scenario: Indexing is expensive but final-answer calls are cheap.
cases.expected: Report amortized and cold-start all-in costs with extraction/embedding/compaction and storage, not answer cost alone.

cases.scenario: User grants full filesystem access but no durable indexing consent.
cases.expected: Do not automatically ingest or retain files; source selection and retention/egress controls remain separate.

cases.scenario: Local-only workspace enables a cloud-based token counter or reranker.
cases.expected: Refuse unapproved content transmission including counting requests; use an allowed local alternative or bounded refusal.

cases.scenario: Opt-in rollout is disabled while capture jobs and user reads are active.
cases.expected: Stop new maintenance/capture safely and preserve authorized manual inspection; no destructive implicit purge.

cases.scenario: Windows and macOS use different path case, locks or SQLite binaries.
cases.expected: Qualify both actual packaged platforms; Linux fixtures do not count as Windows/macOS proof.

cases.scenario: An external engine ignores the offered memory delivery mechanism.
cases.expected: Mark delivery unverified/unsupported and do not claim receipt-equivalent behavior from configuration alone.

cases.scenario: A procedure learned at one company is unsafe in another or assumes a missing capability.
cases.expected: Use environment/scope-specific preconditions and fresh rehearsal; do not transfer an inferred workaround globally.
